messages.subject: The Vault / Hartwell - Counsel's advice (PRIVILEGED)
messages.plaintextBody:
Nathan,

Attached is Catherine Rosenthal KC's advice on merits and quantum (strictly privileged - please keep within the group). In short: she assesses prospects on the bulk of the claim at 70-75%; ventilation and water-treatment are the strongest heads; the Schedule 7 cap is arguably ineffective on the design obligations; and she puts likely recovery at trial, weighted for risk, at £2.1m-£2.5m plus interest and costs.

She recommends issuing promptly and making an early open offer of mediation. Grateful for your authority to issue proceedings in the TCC.

Sarah
